# 8Bit Music Code Studio

[![ci](https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A chiptune studio in **one Python file**, `8BitMusicCodeStudio.py`. It has a Tkinter GUI and a NumPy synth, and every sound is synthesized (no samples).
- **Exports:** music goes out as audio (WAV/OGG/MP3/FLAC) or as code: Python, a JavaScript Web Audio module, JSON, or a compact `.8bt` text score.
- **Ops:** the same engine is a set of intent ops (`compose`, `remix`, `loopify`, `soundpack`, `master`, `critique`…). You can drive them from the `8bms` CLI, a terminal studio, Python, HTTP, MCP or ACP.
- **Platforms:** Linux, macOS and Windows; Python 3.10–3.13.

![screenshot](screenshot.png)

> **Two ways in.**
> **For humans:** install, then run `8bms` for the GUI or `8bms studio` for the terminal studio, and see [getting started](docs/getting-started.md).
> **For agents:** read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and [llms.txt](llms.txt), list tools with `8bms tools`, and connect over [MCP](docs/mcp.md), [ACP](docs/acp.md) or [HTTP](docs/http-api.md).

## Install

| OS | One line |
|---|---|
| Linux / macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/main/install.sh \| sh` |
| Windows (PowerShell) | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/main/install.ps1 \| iex` |

The one-liners fetch from `raw.githubusercontent.com`, so they work only while the repository is public. For a private checkout, run the script from your clone instead: `sh install.sh --source .` or `.\install.ps1 -Source .`.

The installer:
- checks for Python 3.10+ (and prints the winget/brew/apt/dnf/pacman command if it's missing);
- installs with **pipx**, else **uv tool**, else a private venv in `~/.8bms/venv`;
- puts `8bms` on your PATH with no sudo needed;
- tells you if Tk (GUI) or ffmpeg (OGG/MP3) is missing.

Re-running it upgrades.

```sh
sh install.sh --all                 # extras: --audio --midi --mcp --acp --ml (or --all)
sh install.sh --method uv           # force pipx | uv | venv
sh install.sh --uninstall [--purge] # --purge also deletes ~/.8bms (handles, plugins, settings)
```
```powershell
.\install.ps1 -All ; .\install.ps1 -Uninstall -Purge
$env:EIGHTBMS_EXTRAS="all"; irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Without the script**, any of these work (add `[all]` for playback and MIDI):
```sh
pipx install "eightbit-music-code-studio[all] @ git+https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio"
uv tool install "eightbit-music-code-studio[all] @ git+https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio"
git clone https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio && cd 8bit-music-code-studio && pip install -e ".[all]"
python 8BitMusicCodeStudio.py       # no install at all: just numpy (+ tkinter for the GUI)
```

| Extra | Adds |
|---|---|
| `audio` | `sounddevice` for low-latency playback (fallbacks: simpleaudio, winsound, aplay/paplay/afplay) |
| `midi` | `mido` + `python-rtmidi` for Akai APC and MIDI keyboards |
| `mcp` / `acp` / `ml` | nothing extra today; the servers and the tiny model use only the stdlib and NumPy |
| `all` | all of the above |

OGG/MP3/FLAC export needs `ffmpeg` on PATH; WAV never does. More details are in [getting started](docs/getting-started.md) and the [FAQ](docs/faq.md).

## For humans: make music

```sh
8bms                                   # the GUI (demo song on first launch)
8bms studio                            # terminal studio: notes, English, /commands, live meters
8bms compose "chill town theme" --seed 4 --wav town.ogg
8bms loopify @last --wav town-loop.ogg # gapless game loop
8bms soundpack --names jump,coin,hurt --out sfx/
```

## The GUI

| Area | What you can do |
|---|---|
| **Piano roll** | Click to add a note and drag to set its length; drag a note to move it; drag its right edge to resize; right-click or double-click to delete. Shift+click multi-selects and Ctrl+drag box-selects. The velocity lane is at the bottom. Snap options: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 and triplets. Scale highlight and snap-to-scale, chord stamp tool, copy/cut/paste, duplicate, quantize, transpose, undo/redo. |
| **Piano keyboard** | Click keys to audition notes. Ctrl+K plays from the computer keyboard (two rows, Z… and Q…, with −/= for octave). With **Record** on, what you play is written into the pattern. |
| **Drum sequencer** | Step grid for kick, snare, hat, open hat, clap, tom, crash and metal. Click toggles a step, right-click cycles accent/ghost/off, and dragging paints. |
| **Patterns & arrangement** | Each track has patterns A, B, C… with their own length. Drag patterns from the list onto the timeline, drag clips to move them, and drag on the ruler to set the loop region. |
| **Instruments** | Waves: pulse 1 and 2 (duty 12.5/25/50/75%), triangle, noise (long/short LFSR), saw, sine and a 4-bit wavetable. Each instrument has ADSR, volume, vibrato (rate/depth/delay), arpeggio, pitch slide/sweep and duty sweep. Includes 25 presets; you can save or load your own (`~/.8bms/instruments/`). |
| **Mixer** | Per track: volume, pan, mute, solo. Also a master level, with echo, low-pass and bitcrush effects (plus any plugin effects). |
| **Helpers** | Arpeggiator, random melody, random drums, generator styles (boss, town, chill, dungeon…), metronome, tap tempo, swing, BPM and time signature. |
| **Transport** | Play/pause (Space), stop (Home), loop (L), follow playhead (F) and a moving playhead. |
| **Files** | `.8bms` JSON projects, recent files, autosave every 60 s with crash recovery on the next launch, and plugin panels as extra tabs. |
| **Export** | WAV 16-bit 44.1 kHz for the song, the loop, a seamless loop or stems; OGG/MP3/FLAC; Python, JS, JSON and `.8bt`. |

Press **F1** in the app for the full shortcut list. Tooltips are on every control and the status bar shows what happened.

### "Save as code"
- **Python (`--py`):** a standalone script needing only NumPy. It re-synthesizes the song and writes a WAV (`python song.py -o out.wav [--seamless]`). Its output is sample-identical to the app's render (covered by tests).
- **JavaScript (`--js`):** a dependency-free ES module for the browser, Node, Deno or Bun.
  - It exports `SONG`, `createPlayer(ctx, {loop, mode})`, `renderOffline(sampleRate)`, `renderSamples(sampleRate)`, `toWav(...)`, `playNote(...)`, `createMixer(...)`, plus `STEP_EVENTS`, `STEPS` and `STEP_SECONDS` for step-sequencer/game engines.
  - Its exact renderer is a port of the Python synth (duty sweep and bitcrush included) and matches the app's render sample for sample (covered by tests that run it in Node).
  - Usage: `import {createPlayer} from './song.js'; createPlayer(new AudioContext()).start()`. In Node: `fs.writeFileSync('song.wav', toWav(renderSamples()))`.
- **JSON (`--json`):** the fully resolved event list plus instruments.
- **`.8bt` (`--score`):** a compact, human/AI-editable text score that round-trips with the project.

Guides:
- [GUI guide](docs/gui-guide.md)
- [Terminal studio](docs/terminal-studio.md)
- [.8bt score format](docs/score-format.md)
- [Note language](docs/note-language.md)
- [Exporting](docs/exporting.md)
- [MIDI/APC](docs/midi-apc.md) and [testing with real APC hardware](docs/apc-hardware-testing.md)

### `.8bt` score example
```
title Tiny Tune
bpm 132; key C major
inst blip pulse duty=.125 a=.001 d=.08 s=.4 r=.05
track lead inst=blip
pat lead A: o5 l8 c e g >c <b g e c
track bass inst=bass
pat bass A: l4 c3 c3 g2 g2
track drums drum
pat drums A: kick=x...x...x...x... snare=....x.......x... hat=x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.
```

## Akai APC / MIDI controllers (optional)
Install `mido` and `python-rtmidi` (`pip install -e ".[midi]"`). The GUI's **MIDI** menu connects to a port; `8bms midi` lists ports and monitors one. Own an APC? `8bms apc test --report apc-report.md` checks it; see [Testing with real APC hardware](docs/apc-hardware-testing.md).

Built-in mappings:
- **APC mini / mk2:** the 8×8 pads edit drum steps (with LED feedback and a playhead), faders set track volumes, fader 9 sets master, and the scene buttons select patterns.
- **APC Key 25:** pads and the keyboard (played notes are recorded when Record is on).
- **APC40 mk2:** clip grid, faders, master, and play/stop/record.
- **Generic:** any MIDI keyboard.

Plugins can add more mappings.

## For agents: ops, handles, protocols

Every capability is an **op** in a single registry. Each op is also a CLI subcommand, an HTTP route, an MCP tool, an ACP/studio slash command and a Python function.

| Op | Does |
|---|---|
| `compose` | new song from a prompt and/or game context (23 contexts, 14 styles), seeded |
| `variation` · `extend` · `arrange` · `remix` · `humanize` | transform an existing song |
| `loopify` · `stems` · `master` | game-ready audio: seamless loops, per-track stems, loudness and fades |
| `soundpack` | SFX pack (26 SFX in 4 sets) with a manifest and an optional audio sprite |
| `describe` · `critique` · `diff` | read, score and compare songs |
| `suggest` · `intent` | ML next notes/chords/grooves; English → op call |
| `render` · `export` · `gen` · `info` · `check` · `library` · … | basics (full list: `8bms tools`) |

```sh
8bms compose "boss fight, tense" --context boss --seed 7 --fields handle,score   # handle=@3f2a… score=91
8bms critique @last --fields tips
8bms batch examples/jobs.jsonl          # a whole pipeline in one call; "$prev" / "$id" chain handles
8bms tools --json                       # every op with its JSON Schema
```

Token-thrifty by design:
- one-line `key=value` output, with `--fields` to trim it;
- handles (`@last`) instead of score text;
- batch files;
- deterministic seeds;
- machine-readable [schemas/](schemas/), [OpenAPI](schemas/openapi.json), [llms.txt](llms.txt) and [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

| Front-end | Start | Docs |
|---|---|---|
| MCP (Claude Desktop, Cursor, opencode…) | `8bms mcp` | [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md), [skill](skills/mcp-setup/SKILL.md) |
| ACP (Zed, JetBrains…) | `8bms acp` | [docs/acp.md](docs/acp.md), [skill](skills/acp-setup/SKILL.md) |
| HTTP | `8bms serve --port 8765` | [docs/http-api.md](docs/http-api.md) |
| Python | `import eightbit_studio as bms` | [docs/python-api.md](docs/python-api.md) |

Skills (task recipes for agents) are in [skills/](skills/):
- compose-game-soundtrack
- make-sfx-pack
- loop-for-web
- remix-existing-song
- score-format-quickref
- mcp-setup
- acp-setup
- build-plugin

The tiny offline ML model (43 KB, CPU-only, deterministic) is described in [docs/ml.md](docs/ml.md).

## Samples
- [samples/mellow-space-loop/](samples/mellow-space-loop/): a seamless loop as `.8bt`, `.ogg` and a JS module.
- [samples/sfx-platformer/](samples/sfx-platformer/) and [samples/sfx-ui/](samples/sfx-ui/): SFX packs with manifests (platformer includes a sprite).
- `demo.ogg`: the demo song.

Everything is regenerable with the commands in [samples/README.md](samples/README.md).

## Plugins
Plugins can add:
- instruments, waves and effects;
- styles and grooves;
- **ops** (exposed everywhere automatically);
- exporters and importers;
- GUI panels, slash commands and visualizers;
- MIDI mappings and ML backends.

```sh
8bms plugin new effect my-fx && 8bms plugin validate my-fx && 8bms plugin test my-fx && 8bms plugin build my-fx
```
See [docs/plugins/](docs/plugins/README.md), [skills/build-plugin](skills/build-plugin/SKILL.md) and the examples in `plugins/examples/`.

## Development
```sh
pip install -e ".[dev]" && pytest -q   # synth, timing, loops, round-trips, exports, CLI, ops, ML latency, ACP/MCP/HTTP, plugins, docs sync
python scripts/gen_docs.py             # regenerate schemas, CLI reference, AGENTS op table, llms-full.txt
make screenshot | demo | plugins
```
CI runs the tests on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows with Python 3.10–3.13, smoke-tests both installers, and builds and `twine check`s the package.
More: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md).

## Limitations
- The JS player's *live* mode uses band-limited Web Audio oscillators, so it is close to the app but not sample-identical; *exact* mode (the default when bitcrush is on, and for `renderOffline`) matches. Plugin waves/effects aren't embedded in code exports (built-ins are used instead).
- Without `sounddevice`, the playhead is estimated and loop playback restarts a rendered buffer.
- APC mappings follow Akai's published note/CC maps and are tested end to end against a simulated controller, but not yet on real hardware. If you own one, `8bms apc test` produces a report ([how](docs/apc-hardware-testing.md)). The original APC40 (mk1) isn't supported.
- Plugin permissions other than `network` are advisory, and `network` is only blocked (best effort, Python sockets) while `8bms plugin test` runs. Installed plugins run in-process with full Python rights, so install only plugins you trust.
- `.8bt` velocities are stored as 7-bit MIDI values or 3-decimal numbers.

<!-- file: AGENTS.md -->

# AGENTS.md: guide for coding and music agents

> **TL;DR** Run `8bms tools` to list every op. Call ops as `8bms <op> … --fields a,b`, pass songs by handle (`@last`), and chain them with `8bms batch jobs.jsonl`. Every op is deterministic for a `--seed`. The same ops are MCP tools (`8bms mcp`), ACP slash commands (`8bms acp`) and HTTP routes (`8bms serve`). Short index: [llms.txt](llms.txt); everything in one file: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

Install: see the README ([Install](README.md#install)). If `8bms` isn't on PATH, `python -m eightbit_studio <args>` or `python 8BitMusicCodeStudio.py <args>` work from a checkout.

## Output contract
- Default output is one `key=value` line. Use `--json` for one JSON object, `--fields a,b` to keep only some keys, `-q` for none.
- Exit status is 0 on success and 1 on error. Errors are one line, `error: …` (with `line N` for score errors).
- Flags may go anywhere. `--no-plugins` skips plugin loading.
- Song sources: `file.8bt`, `file.8bms`, `.json`, `demo`, `gen:<style>:<bars>:<seed>`, `-` (stdin), `@<handle>`, `@last`.

## Repo map
| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `8BitMusicCodeStudio.py` | the whole app. The engine is everything above `launch_gui`; then the GUI and the CLI (`build_parser`/`main`) |
| `eightbit_studio/` | import shim: `import eightbit_studio as bms`, plus the `8bms` entry point |
| `models/tiny-v1.json` | 43 KB offline ML model ([docs/ml.md](docs/ml.md)) |
| `schemas/` | JSON Schemas (8bt, 8bms, plugin, ops) and `openapi.json`; generated |
| `docs/` | user and agent docs; `cli-reference.md` ops section is generated |
| `skills/` | agent task recipes (`SKILL.md` with frontmatter) |
| `examples/` | batch jobs, Python/HTTP clients, MCP/ACP configs, game-audio scripts |
| `samples/` | small generated loop and SFX packs |
| `plugins/examples/` | wavetable, chorus, synthwave, mml example plugins |
| `scripts/` | `gen_docs.py` (regenerate docs; `--check`), `new_plugin.py`, `build_all_plugins.py` |
| `tests/` | pytest suite, including `test_docs_sync.py` |
| `install.sh`, `install.ps1` | one-line installers (pipx → uv → venv) |
| `.github/workflows/` | CI matrix + installer smoke tests; release build (no publish) |

## Ops
Generated from the registry by `python scripts/gen_docs.py`. Details and args: [docs/cli-reference.md](docs/cli-reference.md#ops) or `8bms <op> --help`.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: ops -->
| op | what it does | CLI |
|---|---|---|
| `render` | Render a song to audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac). | `8bms render <src> [-o out.wav] [--loop] [--seamless] [--bars 1-8] [--stems DIR]` |
| `export` | Export a song as code/data: js, py, json, score (.8bt), project (.8bms) or plugin formats. | `8bms export <src> [--js\|--py\|--json\|--score\|--project PATH] [--to KIND -o PATH]` |
| `gen` | Generate a song in a style. Returns score text, or writes it to out (.8bt/.8bms). | `8bms gen [--style S] [--bars N] [--seed N] [--key K] [--bpm N] [-o out.8bt] [--wav out.wav]` |
| `info` | Summarize a song. | `8bms info <src>` |
| `check` | Validate a score/project; returns ok or the first error. | `8bms check <src>` |
| `presets` | List instrument presets (and user instruments). | `8bms presets` |
| `styles` | List generator styles. | `8bms styles` |
| `score_help` | Show the .8bt score syntax. | `8bms score-help` |
| `compose` | Compose a new song from a prompt and/or game context; reranks candidates by critique score. | `8bms compose <prompt> [--context] [--style] [--bars] [--key] [--bpm] [--seed] [--model] [--candidates] [--loop] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `variation` | Make a variation: same form and harmony, re-voiced melody/rhythm details. | `8bms variation <src> [--amount] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `extend` | Extend a song by N bars: new melody over the existing accompaniment, ending with a fill. | `8bms extend <src> [--bars] [--seed] [--model] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `arrange` | Auto-arrange: keep the melody, add chords (Viterbi), bass and a groove in a style. | `8bms arrange <src> [--style] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `remix` | Remix in another style or context: keeps the melody, new tempo/instruments/harmony/groove. | `8bms remix <src> [--style] [--context] [--bpm] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `loopify` | Make a seamless loop: set the loop region, smooth the seam, optionally render a gapless file. | `8bms loopify <src> [--bars] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `soundpack` | Render a retro SFX pack (WAV files + manifest.json + Howler-style sprite). | `8bms soundpack <names> [--out] [--variants] [--seed] [--sprite] [--sr]` |
| `stems` | Render one WAV per track (plus mix.wav) into a folder. | `8bms stems <src> [--out] [--seamless]` |
| `master` | Master to a loudness target: gain to RMS target, soft limiter, fades; renders a file. | `8bms master <src> [--out] [--target-db] [--ceiling-db] [--fade-in] [--fade-out] [--loop]` |
| `describe` | Describe a song in one paragraph plus key facts (form, chords, range, mood, score). | `8bms describe <src>` |
| `critique` | Score a song 0-100 with metrics and concrete tips (also used to rerank compose). | `8bms critique <src>` |
| `diff` | Structural diff of two songs: settings, tracks, notes added/removed, arrangement. | `8bms diff <a> <b>` |
| `suggest` | ML suggestions: next notes for a pattern, chords per bar, or a groove. | `8bms suggest <src> [--kind] [--track] [--pattern] [--k] [--seed]` |
| `humanize` | Humanize timing and velocity (deterministic per seed). | `8bms humanize <src> [--amount] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]` |
| `intent` | Parse plain English into an op call {op, args, confidence} (no side effects). | `8bms intent <text>` |
| `library` | List the style/preset library: styles, game contexts, grooves, presets, SFX and SFX sets. | `8bms library <what>` |
| `ml` | Tiny ML model: info \| train \| bench (sizes, provenance, latency). | `8bms ml <action> [--out]` |
<!-- END GENERATED: ops -->

## Recipes
```sh
8bms compose "tense boss fight" --context boss --seed 7 --fields handle,score
8bms remix @last --style chase --fields handle
8bms loopify @last --wav boss-loop.ogg --fields loop_seconds,wav
8bms soundpack platformer -o sfx/ --fields count,manifest
8bms master boss.wav --out boss-master.wav --target-db -14 --fields rms_db,peak_db
8bms critique song.8bt --fields score,tips      8bms describe @last --fields summary
8bms intent "make it spookier and loop it"      # -> which op + args to call
8bms export @last --js song.js                  # ES module: SONG, createPlayer, renderOffline, STEP_EVENTS
8bms do "gen town 8; bpm 100; transpose 2; /render t.wav" --save t.8bt
```

## .8bt score (the cheapest way to write music)
```
title Boss Theme            # '#'+space starts a comment ("Boss #3" stays intact)
bpm 150; time 4/4; swing 0; key A minor; master .8
loop 1-8                    # bars, 1-based inclusive
fx echo time=.3 feedback=.3 mix=.2     # also lowpass cutoff=, bitcrush bits= downsample=
inst zap pulse duty=.125 a=.001 d=.1 s=.5 r=.05 vib=.2 arp=0,4,7 slide=-12
track lead inst=zap vol=.7 pan=-.2
pat lead A: o5 l8 c e g >c <b g e c        # pat <track> <name> [bars=N]:  (also lead.A, "Pulse 1" A)
pat lead B bars=2: (a g)x4 f/2. r/4
arr lead: A A B -*1 A                      # '-' empty bar, '*N' repeat
track drums drum
pat drums A: kick=x...x...x...x... snare=....x.......x... hat=x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.  # X = accent
```
Note language:
- Notes: `c4 c#4 db4`, or a bare `c` (uses the current octave, `o5`). `>` / `<` shift the octave.
- Lengths: `l8` sets the default; per note `/4 /8. /16t` (dotted `.`, triplet `t`); a standalone `_` token ties (extends the previous note by the default length).
- Rests and chords: `r/4` is a rest, `[c e g]/2` is a chord, `{Am}/1` `{G7}` `{Fmaj7}` are chord symbols.
- Velocity: `v100` / `v.8` sets the default; per note `c!.6` or `c!110`.
- Repeats: `( … )x4`. `@192` jumps to an absolute tick (PPQ = 96).

Instruments: `8bms presets`. Waves: pulse (duty .125/.25/.5/.75), triangle, noise (`noise_mode=short`), saw, sine, wave (4-bit table), plus plugin waves.

## Agent front-ends
- **MCP:** `8bms mcp`, with tool `studio` plus one tool per op ([docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md)).
- **ACP:** `8bms acp`, for Zed and JetBrains; prompts can be music, English or slash commands ([docs/acp.md](docs/acp.md)).
- **HTTP:** `8bms serve --port 8765`, with `GET /tools`, `POST /ops/<name>`, `POST /batch` and `POST /prompt` ([docs/http-api.md](docs/http-api.md)).
- **Terminal studio:** `8bms studio`; one-shot `8bms do "…"`.

## Plugins (short)
```sh
8bms plugin list | info <name> | enable <name> | disable <name>
8bms plugin new <type> <name>      # types: instrument effect style op exporter importer gui command visualizer midi ml
8bms plugin validate <dir> && 8bms plugin test <dir> && 8bms plugin build <dir>   # build = wheel; package = zip
8bms plugin install <dir|zip|wheel|git-url|pip-spec>    8bms plugin uninstall <name>
```
- Search order: `~/.8bms/plugins`, `plugins/` in the cwd (examples load only when run from the repo), `$EIGHTBMS_PLUGIN_PATH`, then entry points `eightbit_studio.plugins`.
- Op plugins become CLI subcommands (`8bms <op> --arg v`), MCP tools, HTTP routes and ACP slash commands automatically.
- Full guide: `docs/plugins/`. Skill: `skills/build-plugin/SKILL.md`. Examples: `plugins/examples/{wavetable,chorus,synthwave,mml}`.

## Working on this repo
- Run `pytest -q` before committing. Tests cover the engine, ops, ML latency budgets, protocols, plugins, the GUI (skipped without Tk/display) and docs sync.
- After changing an op, a schema or a doc, run `python scripts/gen_docs.py`. `tests/test_docs_sync.py` fails when generated files are stale.
- Keep the engine free of tkinter imports, keep every random choice seeded, and use `pathlib` + UTF-8 (CI runs on Windows).
- Do not commit large binaries. Samples stay small and must be regenerable (see `samples/README.md`).


---

<!-- file: docs/getting-started.md -->

# Getting started

> **TL;DR** One line installs `8bms`; then `8bms` opens the GUI, `8bms studio` opens the terminal studio and `8bms compose "..." --wav out.wav` makes music from a sentence.

## 1. Install

| System | One line |
|---|---|
| Linux / macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/main/install.sh \| sh` |
| Windows (PowerShell) | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/main/install.ps1 \| iex` |

What the installer does:
1. Finds Python 3.10+ (preferring one with Tk for the GUI). If none is found, it prints the exact `winget` / `brew` / `apt` / `dnf` / `pacman` command to run.
2. Installs with **pipx** if you have it, else **uv tool**, else a private venv at `~/.8bms/venv`.
3. Puts `8bms` on your PATH (`~/.local/bin` or `~/.8bms/bin`; on Windows, your *user* PATH). It never uses sudo or admin rights.
4. Warns if `tkinter` is missing (Linux: `sudo apt-get install python3-tk`); everything except the GUI still works.

Options:
```sh
curl -fsSL .../install.sh | sh -s -- --all            # extras: --all --audio --midi --mcp --acp --ml
sh install.sh --uninstall                             # add --purge to also delete ~/.8bms (handles, plugins)
```
```powershell
$env:EIGHTBMS_EXTRAS = "all"; irm .../install.ps1 | iex
irm .../install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1; .\install.ps1 -All      # or -Uninstall [-Purge]
```
Re-running the installer upgrades in place.

> The raw.githubusercontent.com one-liners work once the repository is public. Until then, clone the repo and run `sh install.sh --source .` (or `.\install.ps1 -Source .`).

### Manual installs
```sh
pipx install "git+https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio"
uv tool install "eightbit-music-code-studio[all] @ git+https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio"
pip install "eightbit-music-code-studio[midi] @ git+https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio"
```
Extras:
- `audio`: sounddevice, for live playback with an accurate playhead.
- `midi`: mido + python-rtmidi, for Akai APC and other controllers.
- `mcp`, `acp`, `ml`: currently empty (stdlib/numpy only). They are kept so install commands stay stable.
- `all`: everything above.
- `dev`: pytest, pillow, build, twine.

From a clone (for development):
```sh
git clone https://github.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio && cd 8bit-music-code-studio
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate      # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```
No install at all: `python 8BitMusicCodeStudio.py <args>` works anywhere NumPy is installed.

## 2. First five minutes

```sh
8bms                                         # GUI; the demo song loads on first launch
8bms compose "mellow space exploration" --bars 16 --seed 1 --wav space.wav
8bms describe @last                          # what did it make?
8bms loopify @last --wav space-loop.wav      # gapless loop
8bms soundpack platformer -o sfx/            # 10 retro SFX + sprite
8bms export @last --js space.js              # Web Audio module: no audio file needed
8bms studio                                  # terminal studio with live meters
```
`@last` is the handle of the most recent result; every song-making command prints one (`handle=@1a2b3c4d`).

## 3. Where next
- Making music by hand: [gui-guide](gui-guide.md), [score-format](score-format.md), [note-language](note-language.md).
- Automating: [cli-reference](cli-reference.md), [python-api](python-api.md), [http-api](http-api.md).
- AI agents: [agent-framework](agent-framework.md), [mcp](mcp.md), [acp](acp.md).
- Shipping audio: [exporting](exporting.md). Problems: [faq](faq.md).


---
<!-- file: docs/agent-framework.md -->

# Agent framework

> **TL;DR** Every capability is an **op** in one registry. The same op is a CLI subcommand, a `POST /ops/<name>` route, an MCP tool, an ACP/studio slash command and a Python call. Ops take small JSON args, return small JSON results, are deterministic for a seed, and pass songs around as **handles** (`@last`), so agents spend few tokens.

## The intent ops
| Op | Use it to | Key args | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compose` | make a new song from a prompt and/or game context | `prompt context style bars key bpm seed model candidates loop` | `handle score style context bars bpm key notes title` |
| `variation` | same form and harmony, fresh melody/rhythm | `src amount seed` | `handle changed` |
| `extend` | add N bars | `src bars seed` | `handle added_bars` |
| `arrange` | keep the melody, rebuild chords/bass/drums | `src style seed` | `handle` |
| `remix` | new style or context, same melody | `src style context bpm seed` | `handle style` |
| `loopify` | seamless loop | `src bars out wav` | `loop_bars loop_seconds loop_samples wav seam` |
| `humanize` | timing/velocity feel | `src amount seed` | `handle` |
| `soundpack` | SFX pack | `names out variants seed sprite sr` | `dir count manifest sprite` |
| `stems` | one WAV per track | `src out seamless` | `dir stems mix` |
| `master` | loudness, limiter, fades (songs or WAVs) | `src out target_db ceiling_db fade_in fade_out loop` | `path rms_db peak_db gain_db` |
| `describe` | one-paragraph summary | `src` | `summary mood form chords lead_range score` |
| `critique` | 0–100 score + tips | `src` | `score metrics parts tips` |
| `diff` | structural diff of two songs | `a b` | `same changes` |
| `suggest` | ML next notes / chords / groove | `src kind track pattern k seed` | list of suggestions |
| `intent` | English → op call | `text` | `op args confidence alternatives` |
| `library` | styles, contexts, grooves, presets, SFX | `what` | lists |

Utility ops: `render`, `export`, `gen`, `info`, `check`, `presets`, `styles`, `score_help`, `ml`. The full generated list is in the [CLI reference](cli-reference.md#ops).

## Token-thrifty I/O
- **Handles** instead of score text: every song-producing op returns `handle`. `@last` is always the latest.
- **`--fields` / `_fields`**: `8bms compose ... --fields handle,score` → `handle=@ab12cd34 score=98`.
- **Terse default output**: one `key=value` line. Ask for `--json` only when you need structure.
- **Batch**: `8bms batch jobs.jsonl` runs a whole plan in one call (`"$prev"`, `"$<id>"`).
- **Determinism**: the same args and `seed` give byte-identical songs and audio. You can retry without surprises and cache results.
- **Self-description**: `8bms tools` (one line per op), `8bms tools --json`, `GET /tools`, MCP `tools/list`, `8bms schema ops`.

## Library
- **14 styles:** boss, chase, chill, credits, dungeon, gameover, mellow-space, puzzle, stealth, title, town, underwater, upbeat, victory.
- **23 game contexts:** title-screen, menu, overworld, town, shop, forest, dungeon, cave, castle, battle, boss, final-boss, chase, puzzle, stealth, underwater, space, lofi-break, credits, victory, level-clear, game-over, cutscene-sad. Each maps to a style, a length and loop-or-jingle.
- **Other sets:** 10 grooves, 25 instrument presets, and 26 SFX in 4 sets (platformer, shooter, ui, rpg).

See them with `8bms library <styles|contexts|grooves|presets|sfx>`.

## Skills
Task recipes for agents live in [skills/](../skills/):
- `compose-game-soundtrack`
- `make-sfx-pack`
- `loop-for-web`
- `remix-existing-song`
- `score-format-quickref`
- `mcp-setup`
- `acp-setup`
- `build-plugin`

## A typical agent plan
```sh
8bms intent "spooky cave level, short loop"                 # -> op=compose args={context: cave, ...}
8bms compose "spooky cave" --context cave --seed 3 --fields handle,score
8bms critique @last --fields score,tips
8bms loopify @last --wav cave.ogg --fields loop_seconds,wav
```


---
<!-- file: docs/cli-reference.md -->

# CLI reference (`8bms`)

> **TL;DR** `8bms <command> [args]`. Output is one terse `key=value` line by default; use `--json` for JSON, `--fields a,b` to keep only some keys, and `-q` for exit status only. Every song argument accepts a file, `demo`, `gen:style:bars:seed`, `-` (stdin) or a handle (`@id`, `@last`).

```sh
8bms --version
8bms                     # GUI (same as 8bms gui)
8bms --help              # all commands with examples
8bms tools               # every op as a one-line card; --json for full schemas
```

## Global flags
These can go anywhere on the command line.
| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print one JSON object (or list) |
| `--fields a,b` | keep only these result keys (also `_fields` in HTTP/MCP args and `"fields"` in batch jobs) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no output; exit status 0 = ok, 1 = error |
| `--no-plugins` | skip plugin discovery (or set `EIGHTBMS_NO_PLUGINS=1`) |

Errors print one line, `error: …`; score errors include `line N`.

## Song sources and handles
- A source can be `song.8bt`, `song.8bms`, `song.json`, `demo`, `gen:boss:16:3` or `-` (stdin).
- Ops that create a song store it and return `handle=@1a2b3c4d`. Pass `@1a2b3c4d` or `@last` wherever a song is expected; this avoids sending score text back and forth.
- Handles live in `~/.8bms/handles/` (`EIGHTBMS_HOME` moves the whole data dir).

## Core commands
| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `8bms gui [file]` | open the GUI (`--selftest --screenshot shot.png` for headless checks) |
| `8bms studio [file]` (alias `repl`) | [terminal studio](terminal-studio.md) |
| `8bms do "<text>" [--song f] [--save f]` | run studio input non-interactively (`;` or newlines separate) |
| `8bms play <src> [--loop]` | play through the speakers |
| `8bms show <src>` · `info` · `check` | print as `.8bt` / summarize / validate |
| `8bms batch jobs.jsonl [-o results.jsonl]` | run many ops; `"$prev"` / `"$<id>"` reference earlier handles |
| `8bms op <name> k=v …` | run any registered op, including plugin ops |
| `8bms tools [--json]` · `openapi` · `schema 8bt\|8bms\|plugin\|ops` | machine-readable descriptions |
| `8bms serve [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port 8765]` | [HTTP API](http-api.md) |
| `8bms mcp` · `8bms acp` | [MCP](mcp.md) / [ACP](acp.md) servers on stdio |
| `8bms midi [--port P] [--seconds N]` | list MIDI ports / monitor a controller ([midi-apc](midi-apc.md)) |
| `8bms apc test [--port P] [--model M] [--virtual [M]] [--report FILE]` | guided Akai APC check with a Markdown report ([apc-hardware-testing](apc-hardware-testing.md)); `8bms apc models` lists mappings |
| `8bms plugin list\|info\|enable\|disable\|install\|uninstall\|new\|validate\|test\|build\|package` | [plugins](plugins/README.md) |

## Batch example
```jsonl
{"id": "theme", "op": "compose", "args": {"context": "space", "bars": 16, "seed": 1}, "fields": "handle,score"}
{"id": "loop", "op": "loopify", "args": {"src": "$theme", "wav": "out/space-loop.wav"}, "fields": "loop_seconds,wav"}
```
```sh
8bms batch jobs.jsonl            # one JSON result per line: {"id", "ok", "result" | "error"}
```

## Ops
This section is generated from the op registry by `python scripts/gen_docs.py`. Do not edit it by hand.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: ops -->
<a id="ops"></a>

25 ops, generated from the registry (`8bms tools --json` has full input schemas). Every op also takes `_fields` (CLI `--fields`) to trim its result.

### `render`

Render a song to audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac).

```sh
8bms render <src> [-o out.wav] [--loop] [--seamless] [--bars 1-8] [--stems DIR]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | file .8bt/.8bms, 'demo' or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `out` | string | `"out.wav"` | output file (extension picks format) |
| `loop` | boolean | `false` | render only the loop region |
| `seamless` | boolean | `false` | gapless loop file: loop region (or --bars) with the tail folded into the start |
| `bars` | string |  | bar range like 1-8 |
| `stems` | string |  | also write per-track stems into this folder |

### `export`

Export a song as code/data: js, py, json, score (.8bt), project (.8bms) or plugin formats.

```sh
8bms export <src> [--js|--py|--json|--score|--project PATH] [--to KIND -o PATH]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song source |
| `kind` | string | required | exporter name |
| `out` | string |  | output path (default from title) |

### `gen`

Generate a song in a style. Returns score text, or writes it to out (.8bt/.8bms).

```sh
8bms gen [--style S] [--bars N] [--seed N] [--key K] [--bpm N] [-o out.8bt] [--wav out.wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | string | `"mellow-space"` | style name |
| `bars` | integer | `16` | length in bars |
| `seed` | integer |  | random seed |
| `key` | string |  | key like C, F#, Bb |
| `bpm` | number |  | tempo |
| `out` | string |  | write score/project here |
| `wav` | string |  | also render a WAV |

### `info`

Summarize a song.

```sh
8bms info <src>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song source |

### `check`

Validate a score/project; returns ok or the first error.

```sh
8bms check <src>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | file |

### `presets`

List instrument presets (and user instruments).

```sh
8bms presets
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|

### `styles`

List generator styles.

```sh
8bms styles
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|

### `score_help`

Show the .8bt score syntax.

```sh
8bms score-help
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|

### `compose`

Compose a new song from a prompt and/or game context; reranks candidates by critique score.

```sh
8bms compose <prompt> [--context] [--style] [--bars] [--key] [--bpm] [--seed] [--model] [--candidates] [--loop] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | `""` | free text, e.g. 'tense boss fight 16 bars in E' |
| `context` | string |  | game context: title-screen, menu, overworld, town, shop, forest, dungeon, cave, castle, battle, boss, final-boss, chase, puzzle, stealth, underwater, space, lofi-break, credits, victory, level-clear, game-over, cutscene-sad |
| `style` | string |  | style (overrides context) |
| `bars` | integer |  | length in bars |
| `key` | string |  | key like C, F#, Bb |
| `bpm` | number |  | tempo |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `model` | string | `"tiny"` | tiny (Markov+rules, default) \| rules \| <ml plugin> |
| `candidates` | integer | `4` | generate N and keep the best by critique score |
| `loop` | boolean |  | make it a seamless loop (default: from context) |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | also render audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac) |

### `variation`

Make a variation: same form and harmony, re-voiced melody/rhythm details.

```sh
8bms variation <src> [--amount] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `amount` | number | `0.3` | 0..1 how much to change |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | also render audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac) |

### `extend`

Extend a song by N bars: new melody over the existing accompaniment, ending with a fill.

```sh
8bms extend <src> [--bars] [--seed] [--model] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `bars` | integer | `8` | bars to add |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `model` | string | `"tiny"` | tiny \| rules |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | also render audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac) |

### `arrange`

Auto-arrange: keep the melody, add chords (Viterbi), bass and a groove in a style.

```sh
8bms arrange <src> [--style] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `style` | string |  | style (default: guessed from tempo/scale) |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | also render audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac) |

### `remix`

Remix in another style or context: keeps the melody, new tempo/instruments/harmony/groove.

```sh
8bms remix <src> [--style] [--context] [--bpm] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `style` | string |  | target style |
| `context` | string |  | or a game context |
| `bpm` | number |  | tempo |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | also render audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac) |

### `loopify`

Make a seamless loop: set the loop region, smooth the seam, optionally render a gapless file.

```sh
8bms loopify <src> [--bars] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `bars` | integer |  | loop length (default: whole song) |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | render the gapless loop (wav/ogg) |

### `soundpack`

Render a retro SFX pack (WAV files + manifest.json + Howler-style sprite).

```sh
8bms soundpack <names> [--out] [--variants] [--seed] [--sprite] [--sr]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `names` | string | `"all"` | comma list of sfx and/or sets (platformer, shooter, ui, rpg) or 'all' |
| `out` | string | `"sfx"` | output folder |
| `variants` | integer | `1` | variants per sound (deterministic) |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `sprite` | boolean | `true` | also write sprite.wav + sprite.json |
| `sr` | integer | `44100` | sample rate |

### `stems`

Render one WAV per track (plus mix.wav) into a folder.

```sh
8bms stems <src> [--out] [--seamless]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `out` | string | `"stems"` | folder |
| `seamless` | boolean | `false` | loop region, tails folded (gapless) |

### `master`

Master to a loudness target: gain to RMS target, soft limiter, fades; renders a file.

```sh
8bms master <src> [--out] [--target-db] [--ceiling-db] [--fade-in] [--fade-out] [--loop]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song (file/@handle/demo) or an existing .wav |
| `out` | string | `"master.wav"` | output file |
| `target_db` | number | `-14.0` | target RMS dBFS (~LUFS for chiptune) |
| `ceiling_db` | number | `-1.0` | peak ceiling dBFS |
| `fade_in` | number | `0.0` | seconds |
| `fade_out` | number | `0.0` | seconds |
| `loop` | boolean | `false` | seamless loop render (no fades) |

### `describe`

Describe a song in one paragraph plus key facts (form, chords, range, mood, score).

```sh
8bms describe <src>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |

### `critique`

Score a song 0-100 with metrics and concrete tips (also used to rerank compose).

```sh
8bms critique <src>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |

### `diff`

Structural diff of two songs: settings, tracks, notes added/removed, arrangement.

```sh
8bms diff <a> <b>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | string | required | first song |
| `b` | string | required | second song |

### `suggest`

ML suggestions: next notes for a pattern, chords per bar, or a groove.

```sh
8bms suggest <src> [--kind] [--track] [--pattern] [--k] [--seed]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `kind` | string | `"next"` | next \| chords \| groove |
| `track` | string |  | track name or index (default: lead) |
| `pattern` | string |  | pattern name |
| `k` | integer | `3` | how many |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |

### `humanize`

Humanize timing and velocity (deterministic per seed).

```sh
8bms humanize <src> [--amount] [--seed] [--out] [--wav]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | song: file .8bt/.8bms, @handle, @last, demo or gen:style:bars:seed |
| `amount` | number | `0.3` | 0..1 |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | seed (same args + seed = same result) |
| `out` | string |  | also save the song (.8bt/.8bms) |
| `wav` | string |  | also render audio (wav/ogg/mp3/flac) |

### `intent`

Parse plain English into an op call {op, args, confidence} (no side effects).

```sh
8bms intent <text>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | required | request in plain English |

### `library`

List the style/preset library: styles, game contexts, grooves, presets, SFX and SFX sets.

```sh
8bms library <what>
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `what` | string | `"all"` | all \| styles \| contexts \| grooves \| presets \| sfx |

### `ml`

Tiny ML model: info \| train \| bench (sizes, provenance, latency).

```sh
8bms ml <action> [--out]
```

| arg | type | default | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | `"info"` | info \| train \| bench |
| `out` | string |  | train: where to write the model JSON |

<!-- file: docs/score-format.md -->

# The `.8bt` score format

> **TL;DR** `.8bt` is a line-based text score: `title`, `bpm`, `key`, `inst`, `track`, `pat <track> <name>: <notes>`, `arr <track>: A A B A`. It round-trips with the project file and is the cheapest format for people and AIs to read or write. Validate with `8bms check song.8bt`.

```
title Boss Theme
bpm 150; time 4/4; swing 0; key A minor; master .8
loop 1-8
fx echo time=.3 feedback=.3 mix=.2
inst zap pulse duty=.125 a=.001 d=.1 s=.5 r=.05 vib=.2 arp=0,4,7 slide=-12
track lead inst=zap vol=.7 pan=-.2
pat lead A: o5 l8 c e g > c < b g e c
pat lead B bars=2: (a g)x4 f/2. r/4
arr lead: A A B - A*2
track drums drum
pat drums A: kick=x...x...x...x... snare=....x.......x... hat=x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.
```

## Statements
One per line; `;` also separates. Indented lines continue the previous line. A `#` followed by a space starts a comment (`title Boss #3` stays intact).

| Statement | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `title <text>` | song title |
| `bpm <n>` · `time 3/4` · `swing 0..1` | tempo, meter, swing |
| `key <root> <scale>` | e.g. `key F# dorian` (major, minor, dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, harmonic_minor, pentatonic, minor_pentatonic, blues, chromatic) |
| `master <0..1>` | master volume |
| `loop <a>-<b>` | loop region in bars, 1-based and inclusive |
| `fx <echo\|lowpass\|bitcrush> k=v…` | master effects (`time feedback mix`, `cutoff`, `bits downsample`) |
| `inst <name> <wave> k=v…` | define an instrument: `duty a d s r vol vib vibrate vibdelay arp slide slidetime noise=long\|short` |
| `track <name> [drum] [inst=..] [vol=..] [pan=..] [mute] [solo]` | create or select a track |
| `pat <track> <name> [bars=N] [o=4] [l=8] [steps=16]: <body>` | a pattern; `pat <track>.<name>:` also works |
| `play <track>: <notes>` | shorthand for pattern A, arranged once |
| `arr <track>: A A B - A*2` | arrangement: `-` is an empty slot, `*N` repeats. Without `arr`, patterns play in order |

Pattern bodies are written in the [note language](note-language.md). A drum track can also use grid rows: `kick=x...x...` with `x` hit, `X` accent, `o` ghost and `.` rest, 16 steps per bar (`steps=` changes this).

## Round-trip and tools
- `8bms show song.8bt` prints the normalized score; `8bms check song.8bt` prints `ok=True bars=8 notes=229`, or an error with `line N`.
- `.8bms` is the JSON project format (lossless and larger). Use `8bms export x.8bms --score x.8bt` to convert.
- JSON Schemas: [schemas/8bt.schema.json](../schemas/8bt.schema.json) (statement patterns) and [schemas/8bms.schema.json](../schemas/8bms.schema.json).
- Every command accepts `-` for stdin: `cat song.8bt | 8bms render - -o song.wav`.


---
<!-- file: docs/note-language.md -->

# Note language

> **TL;DR** Inside `pat` bodies, the studio and `8bms do`, you write `o5 l8 c e g > c` style notes: letters with an optional octave, `/len` for length, `!vel` for velocity, `r` for rests, `[c e g]` chords, `{Am}` chord symbols, and `( … )x4` repeats.

| Write | Means |
|---|---|
| `c4 c#4 db4` | a pitch with an octave (`c4` is middle C, MIDI 60) |
| `c` | a pitch in the current octave |
| `o5` · `>` · `<` | set the octave / up one / down one |
| `l8` · `l16t` · `l4.` | default length: eighth, sixteenth triplet, dotted quarter |
| `c/4` · `c/8.` · `c/16t` | per-note length |
| `c%36` | length in ticks (PPQ 96: a 16th is 24 ticks) |
| `c*2` | scale the length (×2) |
| `_` · `_/4` | tie: extend the previous note(s) by the default length / by a quarter |
| `r` · `r/4` · `rest` | rest |
| `[c e g]/2` | chord (any pitches) |
| `{Am}/1` `{G7}` `{Fmaj7}` `{Csus4}` | chord symbol (maj, m/min, dim, aug, sus2, sus4, 7, maj7, m7…), voiced in the current octave |
| `v100` · `v.8` | default velocity (0–127 or 0–1) |
| `c!.6` · `c!110` | per-note velocity |
| `( c d e )x4` | repeat a group |
| `\|` | bar line (visual only) |
| `@192` · `@b3` | jump to tick 192 / to bar 3 of the pattern |
| `kick/8 snare hat/16` | drum hits by name (in drum tracks) |

Examples:
```
o5 l8 c e g > c < b g e c            # arpeggio up and back
l4 {C} {Am} {F} {G7}                 # I-vi-IV-V7 block chords
o4 l16 (c e g e)x4 | f/2 _/4 r/4     # repeated figure, then a held note
kick/4 snare/4 kick/8 kick/8 snare/4 # a drum bar written as notes
```

Try it live: `8bms do "o5 l8 c e g >c" --save t.8bt`, or type the notes into `8bms studio` (Tab completes, and `/suggest` proposes the next note).


---
<!-- file: docs/gui-guide.md -->

# GUI guide

> **TL;DR** Run `8bms` (or `8bms gui`). Draw notes in the piano roll, paint drums in the step grid, drag patterns onto the timeline, press Space to play, and use **AI ▸ Compose** or **Ctrl+Space** for help. Press F1 for every shortcut.

![8Bit Music Code Studio](../screenshot.png)

## Layout
| Area | What it does |
|---|---|
| Toolbar / transport | Play/pause (Space), stop (Home), loop (L), follow (F), BPM, time signature, swing, metronome, tap tempo |
| Tracks (left) | Add/rename tracks, pick an instrument, volume, pan, mute, solo |
| Piano roll | Click to add a note, drag to move it, drag its right edge to resize; right-click/double-click deletes. Shift-click multi-selects; Ctrl-drag box-selects. A velocity lane is at the bottom. Snap 1/4 to 1/32 and triplets; scale highlight and snap-to-scale; chord stamp |
| Piano keyboard | Click to audition notes; Ctrl+K plays from the computer keyboard (Z… and Q… rows, −/= changes octave). With **Record** on, played notes are written into the pattern |
| Drum grid | Kick, snare, hat, open hat, clap, tom, crash, metal. Click toggles a step; right-click cycles accent / ghost / off; drag paints |
| Patterns & arrangement | Patterns A, B, C… per track, each with its own length. Drag a pattern onto the timeline, drag clips to move them, drag on the ruler to set the loop |
| Instrument editor | Waves: pulse (12.5/25/50/75 %), triangle, noise (long/short), saw, sine and a 4-bit wavetable. ADSR, vibrato, arpeggio, pitch slide, duty sweep. 25 presets; save your own to `~/.8bms/instruments/` |
| Mixer / FX | Master level, echo, low-pass, bitcrush, plus plugin effects |

## Menus
- **File:** new, open, open recent, save, save as. Autosave runs every 60 s, with crash recovery on the next launch.
- **Save as Code:** Python, JavaScript, JSON or `.8bt` score. Audio export covers the song, loop, seamless loop or stems as WAV/OGG/MP3/FLAC.
- **Edit:** undo/redo, copy/cut/paste, duplicate, quantize, transpose.
- **Tools:** arpeggiator, random melody/drums, generate in a style, chord stamp.
- **AI** (tiny offline model, see [ml](ml.md)):
  - Compose (tiny model)…
  - Suggest Next Note (**Ctrl+Space**; press again to cycle alternatives)
  - Variation, Extend +8 bars, Humanize, Auto-arrange, Make Seamless Loop
  - Critique, Describe, Chords of this Pattern

  Every AI edit is one undo step.
- **Plugins:** manage plugins and open plugin panels (they appear as extra tabs).
- **MIDI:** connect an Akai APC or any MIDI keyboard ([midi-apc](midi-apc.md)).
- **Help:** shortcuts (F1) and about.

## Recipes
- **Loop for a game:** drag on the ruler over bars 1–8, then *Save as Code ▸ Seamless loop WAV*.
- **Start from an idea:** *AI ▸ Compose*, type "sneaky stealth level", then use *Variation* until you like it.
- **Hand it to code:** *Save as Code ▸ JavaScript* and `import {createPlayer} from './song.js'`.

## Headless check
`8bms gui --selftest --screenshot shot.png` opens the real window, drives every menu handler (including the AI menu) and saves a screenshot. CI runs it under xvfb.
